    42	EXPLAIN = ("Notification bodies are external content relayed verbatim. A scheduled trigger is a stored prompt: the "
    43	           "schedule shows when it was stored, not who wrote it.")

    46	def notif(origin=None):
    47	    """A ReadNotifications tool_result in the real row shape (2026-11-04): a user row whose tool_result content
    48	    is a string starting "[SYSTEM NOTIFICATION"; the fixed explanatory paragraph always present (it contains the
    49	    words "A scheduled trigger is a stored prompt"); one "--- Notification" header line per notification."""
    50	    body = "[SYSTEM NOTIFICATION - NOT USER INPUT]\nExactly 1 notification was queued.\n" + EXPLAIN + "\n\n"
    51	    if origin:
    52	        body += ("--- Notification 1 of 1 · id: dfc64dcd-0000 · origin: " + origin
    53	                 + " · queued at: 2026-11-04T13:04:18Z · reached this session 3s before this read ---\nbody\n")
    54	    return {"type": "user", "message": {"role": "user", "content": [
    55	        {"type": "tool_result", "tool_use_id": "n", "content": body}]}}

    58	SCHED = "scheduled trigger (the stored prompt of a routine or task on this account)"

    62	def write(rows):
    63	    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".jsonl")
    64	    with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as fh:
    65	        fh.write("".join(json.dumps(r) + "\n" for r in rows))
    66	    return path

    69	def run(script, payload):
    70	    r = subprocess.run(["python3", script], input=payload if isinstance(payload, str) else json.dumps(payload),
    71	                       capture_output=True, text=True)
    72	    out = r.stdout.strip()
    73	    if r.returncode != 0:
    74	        return f"exit{r.returncode}"
    75	    if not out:
    76	        return "allow"
    77	    j = json.loads(out)
    78	    if j.get("decision") == "block":
    79	        return "block"
    80	    h = j.get("hookSpecificOutput") or {}
    81	    if h.get("permissionDecision") == "deny":
    82	        return "deny"
    83	    if "advisory" in (h.get("additionalContext") or ""):
    84	        return "advise"
    85	    return "allow"
    86	
    87	
    88	def stop(rows, active=False):
    89	    p = write(rows)
    90	    try:
    91	        return run(STOP, {"transcript_path": p, "stop_hook_active": active})
    92	    finally:
    93	        os.unlink(p)

   101	    finally:
   102	        os.unlink(p)

   199	def trigger(rows, prompt):
   200	    """UserPromptSubmit: the transcript holds the earlier turns; the new prompt arrives in the payload."""
   201	    p = write(rows)

   205	        out = r.stdout.strip()
   206	        return (json.loads(out).get("hookSpecificOutput") or {}).get("additionalContext", "") if out else ""
   207	    finally:
   208	        os.unlink(p)
